states: Verified and prune protected remain independent; unknown, unverified, running, failed, file and snapshot states retain their existing precedence and explanations.
Actual HTTP replacement removes successful verification and prune protection from the same full provider record.
Complete long provider identifiers including literal markup are text, not executable HTML. Workload connection and backup repository stay separate.
interactions: Desktop native Tab/Shift+Tab reaches state action; Enter/Space opens, Escape closes and returns focus.
320px WebKit touch opens/closes both consuming tables; native target is at least 44px high.
Shared Dialog traps focus, makes background inert, restores focus and does not collapse enclosing Coverage. Opening/closing issues no API call.
All ten final desktop/light and narrow/dark captures opened natively. Settled modal bounds/wrapping and page overflow checked.

evidence.preview: Production inventory readers, recovery model, tables, shared Dialog and shipped CSS, compiled as a consuming fixture inside governed offline browser execution; not a full production build.
